en.title: Show HN: OwnTime – A Chess Clock for Your Day's Priorities
en.hook: A creative productivity tool that applies the chess clock concept to manage daily tasks and priorities effectively.
key_takeaways: Applies chess timer mechanics to daily time management
Provides an intuitive interface for allocating and tracking task duration
Helps developers and knowledge workers master time-blocking

帮助开发者和知识工作者实现高效的时间块管理
